$schema: benchmark A/B record (synthetic mini-index, sandbox CPU)
note: Mini reproducible A/B: 20-card index (10 pt-BR + 10 EN twins of TCGdex set me01, same artwork/card ids), 10 degraded fixtures (perspective/noise/blur/dark/rot180/clean), same models (siglip2-base-384 @99f5d40a, PP-OCRv6 medium), same index file, same fixture files, same machine, warm OCR sessions (SigLIP2 session loads lazily on first embed in both runs). This is a REGRESSION benchmark for code changes - NOT a real-world accuracy estimate. Real-photo dev/holdout benchmarks run on the operator PC per benchmarks/card-recognition/README.md.
environment: sandbox Linux x64 (not the operator Ryzen 5 3500); numbers are for RELATIVE A/B comparison only

deltas.decisions: 3 fixtures ID->PROVAVEL (language-uncertain cap: footer OCR degraded, language flagged for review instead of trusted silently); 2 fixtures PROVAVEL->IDENTIFICADO (fast-path margin + pt-BR prior); all 10 languages still correct in both runs
deltas.gains: embedding reuse (-2 SigLIP2 inferences/request: memory stage 1661ms -> 0.3ms), minimal OCR on fast path (route_b 12727 -> 6957ms mean), reduced verification budget on fast path (1950 -> 1181ms)

realPhotoBenchmark: unavailable in this environment (private dev/holdout photo sets live on the operator PC); rerun benchmarks there per recognition/README.md
